# mdzgholi.ge

> 24/7 on-demand sober driver, personal driver, battery charging, jump start, tire change, tow truck, and roadside vehicle services in Tbilisi, Georgia.

mdzgholi.ge connects vehicle owners across Tbilisi and surrounding regions with vetted, professional drivers and emergency roadside assistance technicians within 15–20 minutes. All services operate round-the-clock 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Contact dispatch by phone or WhatsApp: +995 568 83 47 07.

## Services

- [Sober Driver](https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/sober-driver): On-demand sober driver arrives in 15–20 minutes and drives you home safely in your own car. Rates start from 40 GEL.
- [Personal Driver](https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/personal-driver): Dedicated full-time or part-time professional driver hire for daily, weekly, or monthly business and family commuting.
- [Battery Charging & Jump Start](https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/battery-charging): Emergency 12V digital booster jump start, on-site battery diagnostics, alternator testing, and new battery delivery 24/7.
- [Mobile Tire Change](https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/tire-change): On-site tire puncture repair, wheel swap with spare, and air compressor inflation across Tbilisi.
- [Tow Truck / Evacuator](https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/evacuator): 24/7 vehicle towing and emergency evacuation for sedans, SUVs, and commercial vehicles across Georgia.
- [Car Wash Pickup & Delivery](https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/car-wash): Driver picks up your car from your location, takes it for professional detailing/wash, and returns it clean.
- [Airport Transfer & Intercity](https://www.mdzgholi.ge/services/airport-transfer): Fixed-rate meet & greet transfers to Tbilisi, Kutaisi, and Batumi airports, plus intercity routes across Georgia.
